page_note: 本页为报告第147页，包含正文段落与一幅编号为 Figure 4.10 的横向分组条形图，比较2022与2024年城市门户网站服务提供指标的实施率。

heading.title: Implementation of services provision indicators in city portals

components.evidence: two bars per row, blue `2022` above orange `2024`, in each indicator slot
indicator names on the y axis, bars grow rightwards to the 0%-50% axis
`2022` and `2024` swatches printed under the 0%-50% axis line
`48%`, `51%` printed just beyond each bar end, e.g. top two rows
vertical dotted rules at 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%; no horizontal rules
22 long labels stacked down the y axis, e.g. `Online environment-related permit`

new_components.name: percent_sign_on_ticks_and_labels
new_components.evidence: every tick and every value label ends in `%`: `0%`...`50%`, `48%`, `12%`
new_components.why_it_matters: 数值本身自带百分号，解析后文本为 `51%` 而非 `51`，检索时必须匹配带百分号的形式。

new_components.name: figure_caption_rule_bar
new_components.evidence: a solid blue horizontal bar drawn between the caption line and the plot frame
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题块与绘图区之间的装饰条可能被解析为分隔元素，影响标题与表格的归属判断。

new_components.name: plot_frame_box
new_components.evidence: a thin rectangular border encloses the whole plot, labels and legend
new_components.why_it_matters: 外框可能被误判为表格边界，使图形被当作表格结构提取。

difficulty_notes: 数值全部印在图上，读数不构成障碍（步骤2容易）；真正的瓶颈是定位：22个类别×2个年份共44个标记，而42%、24%、27%、21%、38%等数字在图中重复出现2次以上，因此每个值必须同时携带完整的指标名（如 `Online police declaration`）和年份列（`2022`/`2024`）才能唯一定位。若解析器只输出一列数字或把两年份合并，检索到的 42% 无法区分 Procurement platform 与 Online tax declaration。
